visualCharacteristics.purpose: Pill tabs (e.g. Find a Flavour / More from Vuse) with a per-tab View all link; panels are horizontally scrolling carousels of bordered product cards
visualCharacteristics.summary: Pill tabs plus a View all link; panels are horizontal carousels of bordered product cards (badge, price, packshot, name, Add button)

contentPattern.summary: Tabs: 'Find a Flavour' (16 product cards) and 'More from Vuse' (20 product cards); each card links to its product detail page; 'View all' link
contentPattern.structure: one row per tab; cell 1: tab label; cell 2: panel content as rich text. Optional first paragraph containing only a link = the tab's View all link. Then one product card per image: the packshot image first, followed by badge/price paragraphs, H3 product name and a link to the product detail page

reuseGuidance: Use for tabbed product listings (cross-sell, flavour pickers) with prices and per-tab View all links. For image tiles with overlaid text use tabs-tile-carousel; for plain tabbed text use the base tabs block.
